_note: Input to tools/build-decks.mjs. The decks themselves are generated from
data/vocab, data/kanji and data/sentences, so a deck can never contain a
word the corpus does not contain.
Card identity is noteId + ':' + templateId (CONTRACTS C4.2 rule 1). The note
id is derived from the source item id, which is derived from the selection
order, so re-running this script on the same corpus produces the same ids.
That is the whole point: the ledger's foreign key is that string, and an id
that moves discards a person's study history.
Each deck is written twice, once under books/japanese/decks/ for the
Runcible chapter that uses it and once under rappel-site/data/decks/ for
Rappel's own library. Same generator, so they cannot drift.
